data.name: Waste Runner: Critical Waste
data.detailed_description:
WASTE RUNNER: CRITICAL WASTE

What starts with harmless trash—black bags, plastic bottles, cardboard, and urban debris—quickly escalates into high-risk materials. As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter toxic chemicals and radioactive waste that slowly drain your energy and threaten your survival if you carry them for too long. Every decision matters: push your limits to collect more or rush to the nearest bin before your load becomes deadly.

Managing your battery is equally crucial. Charging stations are scattered throughout the city, forcing you to plan efficient routes, balancing speed, capacity, and risk. The heavier your load, the slower you'll move, turning every trip into a tense race against time.

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Drive a waste-collection robot through dense urban levels

  • Collect, transport, and unload garbage into designated disposal zones

  • Manage limited cargo capacity using a trailer system

  • Avoid hazards such as restricted areas, environmental barriers, and moving obstacles

  • Complete objectives under time pressure

  • Optimize routes to improve efficiency and performance

FEATURES OF THIS VERSION OF THE GAME

  • Playable demo content with 1 handcrafted level

  • Top-down/isometric camera for clear tactical navigation

  • Physics-based trailer and cargo system that affects movement

  • Environmental challenges that require positioning and timing

  • Score and performance evaluation based on efficiency

  • Stylized industrial world with a dystopian, polluted theme

  • Keyboard and controller support

WHAT YOU GET IN THE CURRENT VERSION

Level 1 Suburb Streets: A quiet neighbourhood collects only papers, boxes, plastic bags, and bottles. Uses the basic mechanic (Collect/Unload) and can recharge batteries in a specific pod. The objective is to learn the basics of the game. Bobo the bot needs to deal with some protesters and Johny Duster, who keep messing around.

THEME AND SETTING

The game takes place in a near-future city overwhelmed by pollution and abandoned infrastructure. Robots have replaced humans in dangerous cleanup operations, and you are one of the last active units still keeping the system running.

data.short_description: Step into the role of a city garbage collector and face the hidden dangers lurking in the streets. Viewed from a top-down, isometric perspective, the game challenges you to collect, transport, and safely dispose of waste across multiple urban neighbourhoods.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600, AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030, AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 11 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600, AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 Super, AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 MB available space
